tasks.short: Place restock orders for hospital and laboratory supplies.

steps.what: Read hospital supply inventory and reorder points in the {PROCUREMENT}
Walk the store and mark laboratory supplies that are short
Choose the restock orders: item, quantity and supplier
Draft an unsaved supply order from the chosen lines and stop
Check each order line is a counted shortage, then accept
Place only the accepted supply order with the supplier

tasks.design: She still walks the store and chooses each restock line. An unsaved order is assembled from those lines and stops. She checks that each line is a shortage she counted. Only that accepted order is placed with the supplier through {PROCUREMENT}. That placement is the order itself, not a second save.
tasks.previous_blocker: She typed each order from shelf marks, and the send to the supplier was the same typing.
tasks.enabler_now: Item, quantity and supplier are fields she already sets, so the order can be assembled and sent only after she accepts it.
tasks.still_hard: Seeing what is actually short, and choosing a substitute when the usual item is unavailable.
tasks.human_edge: She is the person who sees the empty shelf and decides the quantity.
tasks.altitude: She still decides what to restock. The order is placed only after she accepts the lines. Her week loses the retyping and the separate submit, not the walk.

reach.task: Order clinic supplies after counting what is short
reach.learn: Send the order only after each line matches a shortage the assistant counted.

evidence.claim: Copying an item code, a quantity and a supplier into a purchase order is deterministic. Deciding what is short is not.
Using logs of staff actions to monitor performance needs works-council consent under WOR art. 27.

assumptions: On-hand quantity, reorder point, item code and supplier are fields already kept in {PROCUREMENT}.
When she chooses a line she sets item code, quantity and supplier. That capture stays in the decision at full time.
If a shelf mark names no catalogue item, that draft line is empty and she writes it during the check. The 5 rewrite hours are that case, already off the central 20.
Placing the order with the supplier is work she does today. The gated step is that send. She does not write the order in full and then file it again.
She accepts routine restock orders herself. Orders above the clinic spend limit are outside this task.
The placed order is a purchasing record. It is not used to score how fast she orders. Animal health details are not on the order.
unknowns: Whether {PROCUREMENT} can submit to this supplier without a portal login she still completes.
The spend she may release without a second person.
research_questions: Which suppliers already receive an order from {PROCUREMENT} without a second login?

already_counted.description: Her check that each line is a shortage she counted sits in s5 and is not deducted again.

incremental.description: When a shelf mark names no catalogue item, she rewrites that line during the check.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: A shelf mark with no catalogue item leaves about 6 after the 5 rewrite hours already taken off the central 20. When every short names an item code, about 12 remains.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Sell pet food and supplies to customers in the clinic.

steps.what: Ask customers which supplies their animal needs
Read the price and stock of those supplies in the {OTHER} clinic shop record
Sell the supplies to the customers and take payment
Record the customers' supplies sale in the shop record herself

tasks.design: She asks what the animal needs, reads price and stock in the {OTHER} clinic shop record, and sells the item in person. She writes the sale once herself. There is no draft, no second filing, and no approval of that save.
tasks.previous_blocker: The right food depends on the animal in front of her, and the customer decides at the counter.
tasks.enabler_now: Price and stock are already in the shop record. That look does not shorten the conversation or the payment.
tasks.still_hard: Matching a food to the animal and answering the customer's question.
tasks.human_edge: She hears the animal's situation and the customer chooses with her there.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes. She still sells and takes payment. The sale record stays a note she writes, with no gate on that save.

reach.task: Hand a customer the item they asked for and take payment
reach.learn: Keep the counter conversation and the payment with the person. Do not add a second save of the sale.

evidence.claim: Advising a customer and taking payment for pet supplies is a conversation at the counter. A consult-note draft does not choose the food or take the payment.

assumptions: The customer is in the clinic. No email, shipment or message to the customer is built.
She writes the sale once in the clinic shop record. A later filing step is not added, and she does not approve her own save.
Price and stock stay a look she does, because the design does not remove that look.
Upkeep is zero because no machine step is added.
unknowns: Whether the shop record already stores the sale when she takes payment.
research_questions: Does she type the sale after payment, or does the counter already store it?

incremental.description: No machine is added, so upkeep is zero.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The customer conversation, the choice of supplies and the payment stay hers. The saving is 0.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Give anesthetics during surgery and monitor the effects.

steps.what: Read the surgery plan in the {OTHER} animal clinical record
Administer anesthetics during surgery as the vet directed
Monitor the effects on animals through the surgery
Write the dose and the effects on animals into the animal record

tasks.design: She reads the vet's plan, gives the anesthetic, and watches the animal. She writes the dose and the effects once into the {OTHER} animal clinical record. No model drafts that note, and nothing files it a second time.
tasks.previous_blocker: The animal's response is seen only in the room, and a wrong dose harms the animal.
tasks.enabler_now: Nothing new removes that watch. The note stays her own writing in the animal record.
tasks.still_hard: Giving the anesthetic and judging the effects while the surgery is underway.
tasks.human_edge: She sees breathing, depth and the animal's response, and she acts in the room.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes. She still gives the anesthetic and monitors the effects. The note is hers, with no gate whose only purpose is to save it.

reach.task: Watch a patient during a procedure and write what you saw
reach.learn: Keep the drug and the observed effects with the person in the room. Do not file a second copy of a note she already wrote.

evidence.claim: Giving an anesthetic and judging the animal's response is in-room clinical work. A fixed template cannot choose the dose or read the effects.

assumptions: The veterinarian sets the anesthetic plan. She does not choose the drug.
She writes the dose and the effects once. There is no machine copy and no approval whose only act is saving that note.
No recording is made, so there is nothing for a model to draft. Upkeep is zero.
The note is not sent to an owner, another clinic, or a laboratory outside the house.
Human consult-scribe timings in the digest are not applied to this task.
unknowns: Whether a veterinarian countersigns the anesthetic note today.
research_questions: Who may change the anesthetic once surgery has started?

incremental.description: No machine is added, so upkeep is zero.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Giving the anesthetic, watching the effects and writing the note stay hers. The saving is 0.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Restock orders are assembled from lines she already chose and are placed with the supplier only after she accepts them. Selling supplies and giving anesthetics stay with her in the room, including the notes she writes herself.
skills_to_grow: Reject a restock line that is not a shortage she counted.
Keep the food conversation and the payment with the customer.
Refuse a model the anesthetic dose, and do not file a second copy of the effects she already wrote.
role.ambitious_version: The accepted supply order is placed for her. The sale and the anesthetic, including the notes, stay hers.
